verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Sabbaha Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem

Huwal-ladhee akhrajal-ladheena kafaroo min ahlil-kitaabi min diyaarihim li'wwalil-hashri maa zanantum an yakhrujoo wa zannoo annahum maani'atuhum husoonuhum mina Allaahi fa-ataahumu Allaahu min haythu lam yahtasiboo wa qadhafa fee quloobihimur-ru'ba yukhriboona buyootahum bi-aydeehim wa aydil-mu'mineena fa'tabiroo yaa ulil-absaar
Wa lawlaa an kataba Allaahu alayhimul-jalaa'a la-adhdhabahum fid-dunyaa wa lahum fil-aakhirati adhaabun-naar
Dhaalika bi-annahum shaaqqoo Allaaha wa rasoolahu wa man yushaaqqi Allaaha fa-innallaaha shadeedul-iqaab
Maa qata'tum min leenatin aw taraktumoohaa qaa'imatan alaa usoolihaa fabi'idhni Allaahi wa liyukhziyal-faasiqeen
Wa maa afaa'a Allaahu alaa rasoolihi minhum famaa awjaftum alayhi min khaylin wa laa rikaabin wa laakinna Allaaha yusallitu rusulahu alaa man yashaa'u Wallaahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

Maa afaa'a Allaahu alaa rasoolihi min ahlil-quraa falillaahi wa lir-rasooli wa lidhil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wabnis-sabeeli kay laa yakoona doolatan baynal-aghniyaa'i minkum wa maa aataakumur-rasoolu fakhudhoohu wa maa nahaakum anhu fantahoo wattaqoo Allaaha innallaaha shadeedul-iqaab
Lilfuqaraa'il-muhaajireenal-ladheena ukhrijoo min deeaarihim wa amwaalihim yabtaghoona fadlan mina Allaahi wa ridwaanan wa yansuroona Allaaha wa rasoolahu ulaa'ika humus-saadiqoon

Wal-ladheena tabawwa'ud-daara wal-eemaana min qablihim yuhibboona man haajara ilayhim wa laa yajidoona fee sudoorihim haajatan mimmaa ootoo wa yu'thiroona alaa anfusihim wa law kaana bihim khasaasatun wa man yooqa shuhha nafsihi fa-ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon

Wal-ladheena jaa'oo min ba'dihim yaqooloona rabbanaa ighfir lanaa wa li-akhwaaninal-ladheena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaani wa laa taj'al fee quloobinaa ghillan lilladheena aamanoo rabbanaa innaka ra'oofun Raheem

Alam taraa ilal-ladheena naafaqoo yaqooloona li'khwaanihimul-ladheena kafaroo min ahlil-kitaabi la-in ukhrijtum lanakhrujanna ma'akum wa laa nutee'u feekum ahadan abadan wa in qootiltum lanansurannakum Wallaahu yashhadu innahum lakaadhiboon
La-in ukhrijoo laa yakhrujoona ma'ahum wa la-in qootiloo laa yansuroonahum wa la-in nasaroohum layuwallunnal-adbaara thumma laa yunsaroon
La-antum ashaddu rahbatan fee sudoorihim mina Allaahi dhaalika bi-annahum qawmun laa yafqahoon
Laa yuqaatiloonakum jamee'an illaa fee quran muhassanatin aw min waraa'i judurin ba'suhum baynahum shadeedun tahsabuhum jamee'an wa quloobuhum shattaa dhaalika bi-annahum qawmun laa ya'qiloon
Kamathalil-ladheena min qablihim qareeban dhaaqoo wabaala amrihim wa lahum adhaabun aleem
Kamathalish-shaytaani idh qaala lil-insaani ukfur falammaa kafara qaala innee baree'un minka innee akhaafu Allaaha rabbal-aalameen
Fakaana aaqibatahumaa annahumaa fin-naari khaalidayni feehaa wa dhaalika jazaa'uz-zaalimeen
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo ittaqoo Allaaha wa ltanzur nafsun maa qaddamat lighadin wattaqoo Allaaha innallaaha khabeerun bimaa ta'maloon
Wa laa takoonoo kal-ladheena nasoo Allaaha fa-ansaahum anfusahum ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
Laa yastawee ashaabun-naari wa ashaabul-jannati ashaabul-jannati humul-faa'izoon
Law anzalnaa haadhal-qur'aana alaa jabalin lara'aytahu khaashi'an mutasaddi'an min khashyati Allaahi wa tilkal-amthaalu nadribuhaa lin-naasi la-allahum yatafakkaroon
Huwallaahul-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huwa aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadati huwar-Rahmaanur-Raheem
Huwallaahul-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huwal-malikul-quddoosus-salaamul-mu'minul-muhayminul-azeezul-jabbaarul-mutakabbiru subhaanallaahi ammaa yushrikoon
Huwallaahul-khaaliqul-baari'ul-musawwiru lahul-asmaa'ul-husnaa yusabbihu lahu maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem
